_comment: Example schema for role-based permissions (stored encrypted inside data/settings.enc under permissions.roleMap).
_note: requiredRoles contains Discord Role ID strings. Empty array = all members allowed.
_note2: requireAll: false → member needs ANY one of the listed roles. true → member needs ALL.

schedule.description: Moderators and above can manage schedules

status.description: Moderators and above can view system status

ask.description: All members may ask AI questions

logs.description: Moderators and above can view logs
